name: A_FETCH_VIRUSTOTAL
description: URL / domain / IP / file-hash reputation via VirusTotal v3. Input: ioc (URL, domain, hash, or IP) OR ip (for a per-IP enrichment map) - auto-detects the IOC type and uses the matching v3 endpoint (IPv4 -> /ip_addresses/). Stub-safe: when VT_API_KEY is unset, prints intent and returns a canned 3/70-vendors-flagged verdict so demo flows run offline.
